simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית פֶּלֶט (H1046) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית פֶּלֶט (Bêyth Peleṭ) means Beth-Palet , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 27.

definitions.full: H1046. Beth Palet מָּ֑לֶט בֵּית proper name, of a location ( place of escape ) in south of Judah Josh 15:27 ; Neh 11:26 ; compare adjective, of a people הַמַּלְטִי 2Sam 23:26 , & so read also 1Chr 11:27 ; 27:10 (Be).
